SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'post' AS type, title AS name, '封面' AS field FROM blog_post WHERE cover_image LIKE CONCAT('%/media/', #{resourceId}, '%')
UNION ALL SELECT 'post' AS type, title AS name, '正文' AS field FROM blog_post WHERE content LIKE CONCAT('%/media/', #{resourceId}, '%')
UNION ALL SELECT 'moment' AS type, COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(content, 30), ''), '生活动态') AS name, '配图' AS field FROM blog_moment WHERE images LIKE CONCAT('%/media/', #{resourceId}, '%')
UNION ALL SELECT 'moment' AS type, COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(content, 30), ''), '生活动态') AS name, '正文' AS field FROM blog_moment WHERE content LIKE CONCAT('%/media/', #{resourceId}, '%')
UNION ALL SELECT 'interview' AS type, title AS name, '正文' AS field FROM blog_interview WHERE content LIKE CONCAT('%/media/', #{resourceId}, '%')
UNION ALL SELECT 'link' AS type, name AS name, '图标' AS field FROM blog_link WHERE logo LIKE CONCAT('%/media/', #{resourceId}, '%')
UNION ALL SELECT 'link' AS type, name AS name, '描述' AS field FROM blog_link WHERE description LIKE CONCAT('%/media/', #{resourceId}, '%')
UNION ALL SELECT 'site-config' AS type, '站点配置' AS name, '头像' AS field FROM blog_site_config WHERE avatar LIKE CONCAT('%/media/', #{resourceId}, '%') ) refs ORDER BY type, name
